description: Exon and intron architecture of the four beta-tubulin loci, showing the isotype-2-specific loss of the CDS nt 1278 junction
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
OUT=os.getcwd()
E=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"exon_structure_PRJEB506.tsv"),sep="\t")
E["exons"]=E["exon_lens"].apply(lambda s:[int(x) for x in str(s).split(",")])
order=["HCON_00043670","HCON_00005260","HCON_00164580","HCON_00167340"]
E=E.set_index("gene").loc[order].reset_index()

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(14,7.4),gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1.35,1],hspace=0.42))

# --- A: exon maps in CDS coordinates ---
ax=axes[0]
cols=["#2f6f4e","#b3453a","#4a6fa5","#8a6aa8"]
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(E.iterrows()):
    y=len(E)-1-i
    pos=0
    for j,L in enumerate(r["exons"]):
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((pos,y-0.26),L,0.52,facecolor=cols[i],
                               edgecolor="white",lw=1.1))
        pos+=L
    ax.text(-30,y,f"{r['gene']}\n{r['label']}",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(pos+18,y,f"{r['n_cds_exons']} CDS exons, {r['cds_len']} nt",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-430,1760); ax.set_ylim(-0.75,len(E)-0.25)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("position in the coding sequence (nt)")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
# mark the junction isotype-1 has and isotype-2 lacks
ax.axvline(1278,color="#b3453a",ls="--",lw=1.3,ymin=0.08,ymax=0.95)
ax.text(1288,3.52,"junction at CDS nt 1278\npresent in isotype-1 and both chr X genes,\nabsent from isotype-2",
        fontsize=8.6,color="#b3453a",va="top")
for v in [57,166,393,522,685,876,972,1159]:
    ax.plot([v],[-0.6],marker="^",ms=4,color="#444a52")
ax.text(0,-0.78,"▲ the 8 junction positions shared by isotype-1 and isotype-2",fontsize=8.5,color="#444a52")
ax.set_title("CDS exon structure of the four annotated H. contortus beta-tubulin loci (WBPS19 PRJEB506)",
             fontsize=11.5,loc="left")

# --- B: intron lengths at the shared junctions ---
ax2=axes[1]
i2=[int(x) for x in E.loc[E.gene=="HCON_00043670","intron_lens"].iloc[0].split(",")]
i1=[int(x) for x in E.loc[E.gene=="HCON_00005260","intron_lens"].iloc[0].split(",")][:8]
x=np.arange(8); w=0.38
ax2.bar(x-w/2,i2,w,color="#2f6f4e",label="HCON_00043670 isotype-2")
ax2.bar(x+w/2,i1,w,color="#b3453a",label="HCON_00005260 isotype-1")
for k,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(i2,i1)):
    ax2.text(k-w/2,a+18,str(a),ha="center",fontsize=8.4)
    ax2.text(k+w/2,b+18,str(b),ha="center",fontsize=8.4)
ax2.set_xticks(x); ax2.set_xticklabels([f"intron {k+1}\nat CDS nt {v}" for k,v in
                  enumerate([57,166,393,522,685,876,972,1159])],fontsize=8.4)
ax2.set_ylabel("intron length (nt)"); ax2.set_ylim(0,1420)
ax2.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9.5)
ax2.set_title("The two loci place introns at identical CDS positions but the introns themselves share no length",
              fontsize=11,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax2.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3); ax2.set_axisbelow(True)
plt.show()

print("genomic span: isotype-2", int(E.loc[E.gene=="HCON_00043670","genomic_span"].iloc[0]),
      "nt vs isotype-1", int(E.loc[E.gene=="HCON_00005260","genomic_span"].iloc[0]),"nt")
print("intron length correlation (8 shared positions): r =",
      round(float(np.corrcoef(i2,i1)[0,1]),3))
